page_title: STR 1-0 NAN | Strasbourg v Nantes 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+7' Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
90+5' The yellow card goes to Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg).
90+3' The Strasbourg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' A snap shot by Rafael Luis (Strasbourg) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes produces a good save to thwart him.
87' The resulting corner, taken by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg), comes to nothing.
86' There's an opportunity for Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
86' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Strasbourg force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) is brought on as a substitute for Yassine Benhattab.
85' Johann Lepenant will be replaced by Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes).
81' 1 - 0 Goal! Dilane Bakwa produces a brilliant lofted pass and Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
81' CHANCE! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Abdoul Ouattara.
79' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
77' Strasbourg are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Felix Lemarechal as he is replaced by Rafael Luis (Strasbourg).

74' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Anthony Lopes easily catches the ball.
71' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Louis Leroux is replaced by Hyun-Seok Hong (Nantes).
70' A mistake by a defender gifts Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
68' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) sends a chip pass into the box, but Anthony Lopes is quickest to intercept the ball.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Here is a change. Samir El Mourabet is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
64' A substitution has been made. Kendry Paez is replaced by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg).

63' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Karl-Johan Johnsson pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
62' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Strasbourg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Hyeok-Kyu Kwon (Nantes) replaces Francis Coquelin.
56' Substitution. Bahereba Guirassy is replaced by Matthis Abline (Nantes).
55' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' This is a yellow card! Francis Coquelin (Nantes) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
53' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul after Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) hacks down one of his opponents. Nantes win a free kick.
50' Strasbourg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Liam Rosenior probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Sebastian Nanasi. He is replaced by Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Karl-Johan Johnsson has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
43' Poor challenge! Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) is penalised for tripping and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle.
41' Andrew Omobamidele is substituted due to injury. Liam Rosenior gives a chance to Valentin Barco (Strasbourg).
39' The game is interrupted now, Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' Louis Leroux (Nantes) is about to take a corner kick.
36' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

36' What a wasted opportunity by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Karl-Johan Johnsson makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Corner kick. Nantes will have an opportunity.

33' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
31' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes.
29' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
26' 3:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
22' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
22' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg), but it's just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
18' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
18' A cross from Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play and Strasbourg manage to earn a corner.
15' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for an infringement. Strasbourg will take a free kick.
13' Nantes showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
10' The resulting corner from Louis Leroux (Nantes) is cleared.
9' Good work from Nantes as they win a corner.
8' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
7' Great teamplay by Strasbourg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
2' A pass from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Anthony Lopes and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy was nominated as the referee for this game.
